label: Bible Study
prompt: And my spirit hath _____ in God my Saviour.
verse: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
note: Mary's song continues — she calls God her Saviour before her son is even born.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: _____ is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
verse: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
note: Whatever God calls you to, He also does — faithful is He that calleth.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap _____ of fire on his head.
verse: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
note: Feeding your enemy 'heaps coals of fire on his head' — Paul quoting Proverbs 25:22, a kindness that burns.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the _____ of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verse: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
note: Paul's one boast: the cross, which ended his relationship with the world in both directions.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, _____; and some, pastors and teachers;
verse: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
note: Christ's gifts to the church: apostles, prophets, 'evangelists,' pastors and teachers — for perfecting the saints.
